result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane arterial road with high-visibility crosswalks and sidewalks, but lacks pedestrian refuge islands. The long crossing distance and commercial environment suggest a high-speed vehicle priority design that increases pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground.

hazards.name: High Speed Environment
hazards.description: Wide lane widths and lack of vertical elements like trees suggest a design that encourages higher vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant trees along the sidewalk to provide a buffer and create a sense of enclosure that naturally slows traffic.

result.summary: The image shows a wide signalized intersection in a commercial area featuring a high-visibility continental crosswalk and curb ramps. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the long crossing distance across multiple lanes and the lack of a median refuge or dedicated bike lanes create a high-exposure environment.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the marked continental crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Bike Infrastructure
hazards.description: A cyclist is observed using the sidewalk and curb ramp area, indicating a lack of safe, dedicated on-road facilities.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image near the curb ramp.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians at the corner.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

result.summary: The intersection features standard pedestrian infrastructure including high-visibility zebra crosswalks, sidewalks in good condition, and signalized control. However, the lack of physical traffic calming or pedestrian refuge areas on this roadway increases exposure risk for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire roadway width without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the zebra crosswalk.

hazards.name: Potential for high vehicle speeds
hazards.description: The straight, wide roadway design lacks physical speed-reduction measures, which may encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a raised crosswalk to act as a speed table, slowing traffic and prioritizing pedestrian movement.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: This residential intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and signalized traffic control, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway and parked vehicles near the corners create sightline obstructions and increase exposure time for those crossing.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners may block the line of sight between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection along the curb near the row houses.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: The lack of a pedestrian refuge island on a relatively wide street increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Main crosswalk across the primary roadway in the foreground.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.
